title: Casting and how Player got into Treme
summary: How extras and stars are chosen; drummer Gus Johnson called Player to be part of it.

venues.name: New Orleans Center for Creative Arts

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Did they take auditions for people to get in on the thing?

Yeah, you know, I think that they, you know I’m not sure how all of that completely works, but I mean I think that they make posts for like if they need extras for particular shots or whatever. I don’t know what their process is like to get the stars of the show. However, I do know that the main character, he is a New Orleanian, if I understand correctly, and I think he went to the New Orleans Center for the Creative Arts, which is a great school there for high school students. And then the other part is kind of like with jazz gigs, like somebody you know just calls you up and says, “hey man can you do this?” And I mean that’s the way it was for me. You know one of my buddies, a jazz drummer, Gus Johnson, whose passed away now, when I was in the scene that I was in, he called me up and said, “I’ve got this deal in the ‘Treme,’ man, you should come and check it out and be part of it.”
